short.en: It was a long shot, but it was worth trying.
short.zh: 希望虽渺茫，但值得一试。
short.note: long shot 意为“胜算不大的尝试”；worth doing 结构。

short.en: ICE officers arrested two passengers, a father and daughter, as they were boarding a flight in Seattle on Saturday.
short.zh: 周六，ICE 官员逮捕了两名在西雅图登机的乘客，一对父女。

short.en: Massive protests start in Ukraine after President Viktor Yanukovych suspended signing the Ukraine–European Union Association Agreement.
short.zh: 在总统维克托·亚努科维奇暂停签署《乌克兰-欧盟联系国协定》后，乌克兰爆发大规模抗议活动。

short.en: The deadliest November tornado outbreak in U.S. history kills 76 people and injures more than 400.
short.zh: 美国历史上最致命的 11 月龙卷风爆发，造成 76 人死亡，400 多人受伤。

short.en: The Chinese People's Liberation Army declares a unilateral ceasefire in the Sino-Indian War.
short.zh: 中国人民解放军宣布在中印战争中单方面停火。

short.en: It's not bragging if you can back it up.
All that glitters is not gold.
short.note: glitter 双 /l/；gold 的 /oʊ/ 饱满。

short.en: Tony Blair becomes the first Prime Minister of the United Kingdom to address the Oireachtas, the parliament of the Republic of Ireland.
short.zh: 托尼·布莱尔成为第一位在爱尔兰共和国议会发表讲话的英国首相。

short.en: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.
World War II: Romania becomes a signatory of the Tripartite Pact, officially joining the Axis powers.
short.zh: 第二次世界大战：罗马尼亚成为《三国同盟条约》的签署国，正式加入轴心国。

short.en: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".
short.zh: 在他的家人向意大利媒体发表的声明中，他们称其为“我们这个时代最伟大的珠宝商”。

short.en: Attitude drives actions. Actions drive results. Results drive lifestyles.
Could you send me that report by the end of this week?
short.zh: 你能在本周末前把那份报告发给我吗？
short.note: by 后接期限“之前”；report 双音节。

short.en: An SUV plows through a Christmas parade in Waukesha, Wisconsin, killing six and injuring 62.
short.zh: 一辆SUV冲入威斯康星州沃基肖市的圣诞游行队伍，造成6人死亡，62人受伤。

short.en: In England, a fire breaks out in Windsor Castle, badly damaging the castle and causing over £50 million worth of damage.
Hasina has spoken several times of her desire to return, but this is the first time she has set a date.
short.zh: 哈西娜曾多次表示希望回国，但这是她第一次确定回国日期。

short.en: I wish people would love everybody else the way they love me. It would be a better world.
German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.
short.zh: 德国媒体称，俄罗斯计划在未来几周内向太空发射一颗携带核弹头的卫星。

short.en: John Carpenter becomes the first person to win the top prize in the TV game show Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
short.zh: 约翰·卡彭特 (John Carpenter) 成为电视游戏节目《谁想成为百万富翁？》中第一个获得最高奖项的人。

short.en: I could really use a cup of coffee right now.
short.note: could use 表示“很需要”；really 弱读。

long.en: George W. Bush is certified the winner of Florida's electoral votes by Katherine Harris, going on to win the United States presidential election, despite losing in the national popular vote.
long.zh: 凯瑟琳·哈里斯 (Katherine Harris) 确认乔治·W·布什 (George W. Bush) 赢得了佛罗里达州选举人票，尽管在全国普选中落败，但他仍将赢得美国总统选举。

long.en: Is life so dear, or peace so sweet, as to be purchased at the price of chains and slavery? I know not what course others may take; but as for me, give me liberty, or give me death!
long.zh: 生命果真如此宝贵，和平果真如此甜美，竟值得以枷锁和奴役为代价吗？我不知道别人会如何选择；至于我，不自由，毋宁死。
long.note: 问句语调上扬；chains and slavery 连读；结尾 give me liberty, or give me death 逐词加重。

long.en: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.
long.zh: 我步入丛林，是因为我希望活得清醒，只面对生活中最本质的事实，看看能否学到生活要教给我的东西；免得临终时才发现自己从未真正活过。
long.note: deliberately 重音在第二音节；essential /ɪˈsenʃl/；长句在 and not 处停顿。

n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学
n. 国库, 宝库, 财政部, 国库券
a. 天资高的, 有才能的
n. 王冠, 王权, 顶点
a. 赤裸的, 缺少的, 无遮蔽的, 坦率的
a. 看不见的, 无形的
